**Install:** download `fazon_track.lua` into VLC's `lua/extensions` folder (see the
[README](https://github.com/SomeRandomGuy64/Fazon-Nexus-VLC-Tracker#install) for where that is on
your system) and restart VLC. Then, while something plays, choose **View → Fazon Track**. The
first time, it asks for your fazon.nexus API key.
